live.shuttingDown: The app is shutting down: the check was not started

batch.size: A batch check takes 1 to {{max}} profiles
batch.notEligible: Profile not found, disabled or removed from its subscription

history.invalidRow: The check result is damaged and was not saved

engine.noProbePort: Separate handshake check skipped: the active tunnel has no local SOCKS port available.
engine.noProfile: No profile selected: nothing was checked through a tunnel

media.unreachable: Twitch HLS / CDN servers are unreachable through this tunnel.
media.risk: Twitch error #2000 risk: a TCP-only profile does not block QUIC (UDP/443).
media.guarded: HLS media streams are protected. The QUIC blackhole guard is active (UDP/443 is blocked, browsers fall back to HTTPS/TCP).
media.udp: HLS media streams are reachable. The profile supports UDP/QUIC.

throughput.stable: The stream was steady during the short diagnostic probe.
throughput.unstable: The stream is uneven: compare min/max, stalls and the longest pause with other profiles.
throughput.partial: Not all short samples arrived: {{error}}. Compare the available min/max and stalls with other profiles.

split.disabled: Split tunneling is off: all traffic follows the normal default route.
split.duplicates: The same process_name appears in several rules: {{names}}.
split.direct: The direct route is assigned to {{names}} process names and {{paths}} application paths; other applications go through proxy-out.
split.none: No explicit direct rules: applications go through proxy-out.

privateTarget.title: Server on a private network
privateTarget.detail: Address {{ip}} belongs to a private network; the results only describe the local path.

tlsExpired.title: TLS certificate expires or has expired
tlsExpired.detail: The certificate is valid for {{days}} more days (until {{validTo}})

tlsSanMismatch.title: Host name missing from the certificate SAN
tlsSanMismatch.detail: The certificate was issued for [{{names}}], checked against {{host}}

tlsFingerprintChanged.title: TLS certificate fingerprint changed
tlsFingerprintChanged.detail: The certificate fingerprint changed since the previous check

tlsUntrusted.title: Untrusted TLS certificate
tlsUntrusted.detail: The system did not confirm the certificate chain ({{error}}); for VPN servers with a self-signed certificate this is normal.

httpServerError.title: The server returned an HTTP 5xx error

packetLossHigh.title: High share of failed TCP connections
packetLossHigh.detail: The connection failed in {{pct}}% of attempts

packetLoss.title: Failed TCP connections during the latency check
packetLoss.detail: The connection failed in {{pct}}% of attempts

cidrShared.title: Subnet shared with other servers
cidrShared.detail: The server is in the same /24 subnet as: {{names}}

egressCountryMismatch.title: Exit country differs from the server country
egressCountryMismatch.detail: Traffic exits in {{egress}}, the server is in {{endpoint}}

egressFailed.title: Internet exit (egress) check failed
egressFailed.detail: The reflectors did not confirm an exit through the tunnel
egressFailed.detailError: The reflectors did not confirm an exit through the tunnel: {{error}}

egressPartial.title: Internet exit partly confirmed
egressPartial.detail: One of the exit reflectors did not answer or the answers disagree
egressPartial.detailError: One of the exit reflectors did not answer: {{error}}

egressDiffers.title: The exit IP differs from the connection IP

pmtuBlackhole.title: Suspected PMTU blackhole
pmtuBlackhole.detail: Large packets are dropped without an ICMP reply

lowPmtu.title: Low path MTU
lowPmtu.detail: An MTU of {{pmtu}} bytes was found. This can cause more packet fragmentation.

throughputFailed.title: Could not measure throughput through the profile
throughputFailed.detail: The HTTPS speed probe did not finish.
throughputFailed.detailError: The HTTPS speed probe did not finish: {{error}}

throughputUnstable.title: Speed through the server is unstable
throughputUnstable.detail: Spread of the short samples {{spread}}%, stalls: {{stalls}}, longest pause: {{gap}} ms.

throughputDegraded.title: The profile became noticeably slower than at the previous check
throughputDegraded.detail: The median speed dropped from {{previous}} to {{current}} Mbps.

twitchRisk.title: Twitch error #2000 risk (QUIC blackhole)
twitchRisk.detail: The VPN profile uses a TCP transport without UDP support, but UDP/443 (QUIC) is not blocked. Browsers will try to load media over HTTP/3, which leads to video timeouts and Twitch error #2000.

twitchOk.title: Twitch HLS media streams are protected
twitchOk.detail: HLS video delivery is confirmed. The QUIC blackhole guard is active; browsers correctly use HTTPS/TCP.

twitchUnreachable.title: Twitch HLS servers unreachable
twitchUnreachable.detail: Could not connect to the Twitch video delivery servers through the tunnel.
twitchUnreachable.detailError: Could not connect to the Twitch video delivery servers through the tunnel: {{error}}

splitConflict.title: Overlapping split tunneling rules
splitConflict.detail: One process_name appears in several routing rules.

splitFailed.title: Could not read split tunneling
splitFailed.detail: The state of process-based routing is unknown.
splitFailed.detailError: The state of process-based routing is unknown: {{error}}
